potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User selects a test suite and views detailed analysis results.

steps.element_description: Select a test suite from the list.
Analysis results are shown for the selected suite.

expected_outcome: User obtains detailed insights into the test suite performance and downloads the report.

potential_user_journeys.scenario_description: User applies filters to view specific analysis data.

steps.element_description: Input filter criteria such as test type or date range.
Apply filters to update the displayed analysis results.

expected_outcome: Filtered analysis results are displayed based on user criteria.
